reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Toner 150mL
reviews.text: The essence has a pleasant, a bit slippery texture and no scent. My combination skin absorbs it quite quickly without any residue. Gently exfoliating with moisturization, this product effectively eliminates dead skin cells and regulates sebum production without causing irritation. Moreover, it deeply hydrates dry skin, and since it's made from natural ingredients, it can be safely used on sensitive skin without any irritation. The brand prioritises skin health and safety, using gentle and non-irritating ingredients that are suitable for even the most sensitive and acne-prone skin types.
reviews.zh: 精華質地舒服，有少滑，冇香味。我嘅混合性肌膚吸收得幾快，冇任何殘留感。佢溫和去角質同時保濕，有效去除老廢角質、調節皮脂分泌而唔會引致刺激。而且佢可以深層滋潤乾燥肌膚，由於成分天然，敏感肌都可以安心使用，唔會刺激。品牌重視皮膚健康同安全，採用溫和唔刺激嘅成分，連最敏感同容易爆瘡嘅膚質都啱用。

reviews.text:

呢支用完我會再回購。
